entries.name: Projectile Doctrine V
entries.text: +60% ammo, +50 piercing AP. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Poisons Doctrine V
entries.text: +140 all AP, +60 poison DMG, stacks up to 2x. NOT mandatory per OP verbatim: "most of their strength comes from the Poison Barrage passive, you rarely stack poison on the same unit repeatedly." Top pick.

entries.name: Precision Doctrine V
entries.text: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire. Top pick.

entries.name: Bowmanship Doctrine V
entries.text: Arrow Rain +75% base piercing per hit, +150 piercing DMG. Top pick.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line maximizes Poison Barrage (spell 2) -- 3 volleys by default, with Vet ROF + a ROF doctrine = 4 volleys, all applying the Poison Spread passive; Bottom Line is about constant DPS, hitting isolated units repeatedly to stack the poison passive on them. Top Line is overall better since it massively increases impact during blob pushes; Bot Line is situational vs small groups (rare). Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. OP verbatim notes: "Top Line Doctrines build is kinda whatever as long as you have at least one ROF doctrine (Precision V has +9% ROF) because that will add +1 volley to spell 2." "Poison V allocation tip: if you only have one Poison V doctrine across your warband, prioritize Rattan RoundShield and Rattan Pikes first -- Vipers benefit less from it than the others." Playstyle: Mastery (poison barrage / spell 2) allows a really great poke of poison AOE damage; the barrage spreads a lot even if only a few arrows hit, or the unit is already half dead -- the value stays the same. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle/Doctrine notes (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Don't put' is a literal X placeholder in the OP. Edit timestamp (2026-06-13) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor by about 12 days; Rattan Vipers is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist (the shortlist's Rattan-family entries are Rattan Roundshields and Rattan Pikemen, both confirmed distinct units from Rattan Vipers), so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.
